blockingRules: Every paired reactive must have exactly one scaleCode and one scoring rule.
Every scale must contain 7 reactives: 4 positive and 3 negative.
Every official norm target must have deciles 1..10 and strictly ascending lowerBounds.
Every Likert dimension must contain exactly 5 questions.
No source-only/legacy norm target may be automatically published.
Published AssessmentVersion, ScoringKeyVersion and NormVersion must be immutable.
